_about: Voice scenarios for tests/voice/run.mjs. lines: [text, seconds of silence after it, optional voice] (voices in make-wavs.mjs: en, fr, en2 = a second English speaker, fr2). The WAV starts when the kiosk opens the mic, after her greeting. groups: run a whole group by name (e.g. `wave1`). expect: say / notSay = what the recording of her audio must / must not contain (Deepgram transcript; a string is a phrase, "/re/" a regex, an array means any one of them; digit words are also matched as digits, so "/5 1 4/" matches 'five one four' and '514'); said / notSaid = the same against the text the worker logged for her (before TTS); tools / notTools = take_message, notify_member, alert_emergency, end_conversation, pause, wake, switch; logs / notLogs = regexes on worker log messages; lang = every line she said after the greeting is in this language; goodbyeHeard = every word of her last line is at the end of the recording; ended = the session ended by itself. Goodbye scenarios also require her goodbye in the recording: the room must not close before it plays.

lang_fr.about: Language choice: 'Français' locks French (STT fr-CA, French voice), she stays French and ends on goodbye.
lines: Bonjour, qu'est-ce que vous faites chez Mobile Apps Labs ?

lang_en.about: Language choice: 'English, please' locks English, she stays English and ends on goodbye.
lines: What does Mobile Apps Labs do?
Okay. And where is the office?

pause_wake.about: Pause (#24/#25): 'Stop talking' while she answers stops her and she says how to call her back; two lines from someone else are ignored; her name wakes her and she answers the question.
lines: What does Mobile Apps Labs do? Tell me everything.
So anyway, the meeting moved to three o'clock.
Did you bring the contract? I'll call Nicolas about it tomorrow.

phone_en.about: Phone number (#6), then slowly: digits in groups, then one by one; never 'five hundred fourteen'.
lines: Sorry, can you say it again slowly?

phone_fr.about: Numéro de téléphone (#6), puis lentement : chiffres groupés, puis un par un ; jamais « cinq cent quatorze ».
lines: Quel est votre numéro de téléphone ?
Pouvez-vous le répéter lentement, s'il vous plaît ?

talk_someone.about: Talk to someone (#10): asks the name, notifies the visitor contact (Nicolas), says so and offers a message; ends on goodbye.
lines: Hi, I'd like to talk to someone, please.

infiniview.about: Infini-View (#7/#8): yes she is in Infini-View, touch and pan to move, demo reel web address, the door for a live demo.
lines: How do I move around in here?
Where can I see a demo?

virtual_office.about: Virtual office (#5): where is the office -> virtual office + 74 Turgeon Street; 'I'm already at your door' -> she is virtual, offers to let someone know.
lines: I'm already here, I'm at your door right now.
Hi! What does Mobile Apps Labs do?
Bonjour, je voudrais laisser un message pour le PDG.
Dites-lui que je passerai demain matin pour signer le contrat.
Oui, c'est bien ça. Pas besoin de me rappeler.
Hi, I'm here to see Alex, I have a meeting with him at two.

emergency.about: 911 first, in the same reply as the alert.
lines: Help! There's smoke coming from the hallway!

idle.about: Silence after the language choice: the session ends by itself at SESSION_IDLE_TIMEOUT (120s).

bye_en.about: Short goodbye: the visitor just says 'Thanks, goodbye!'; all of her goodbye must reach the kiosk before the room closes (it was cut at 'Good…').

bye_fr.about: Au revoir court : la visiteuse dit juste « Merci, au revoir ! » ; tout son au revoir doit être joué avant la fermeture.

notify_first.about: 'Here to see Alex' as the very first line, no name yet: nobody is told until the visitor gives a name, then Alexandre is told that David Chen is here.
lines: Hi, I'm here to see Alex, I have a meeting with him at two.

logs: told Alexandre Joset that David Chen is here
notLogs: said she notified someone without notify_member

switch_back_fr.about: Switch to English, then 'est-ce qu'on peut revenir au français ?' switches back. Said twice, as a visitor would when she doesn't answer: the English-locked STT hears nothing of French, and only listens in both languages after that.
lines: Hmm, est-ce qu'on peut revenir au français ?
Est-ce qu'on peut revenir au français ?

logs: visitor asked to switch to en
visitor asked to switch to fr

switch_back_en.about: Switch to French (asked twice: the English-locked STT hears nothing of the first), then 'On peut revenir en anglais ?' switches back.

logs: visitor asked to switch to fr
visitor asked to switch to en

lines: Je voudrais laisser un message pour Nicolas.
Sorry, can we speak English? My French isn't great.

logs: visitor asked to switch to en
notLogs: visitor asked to switch to fr

mention_en.about: English locked: a French restaurant, French cooking are mentions, not requests.

mention_fr.about: Français verrouillé : « Mon collègue parle anglais » n'est pas une demande.
